The empties pass (section 6), declared before any decision. All 167 empty lines of assignments_final.jsonl are B4 rulings carried unresolved (classes 3 to 5; 114 scheme-ambiguous, 53 author-disagrees; both B3 readers placed a theme in every one; my B1 in 131). 167 of 7,844 is 2.1%, below one in five, so no finding goes to the top of notes-C1.md. Each is read whole (c1_empties.py packets, in B1's reading order from saturation.py) as a re-read of its B4 ruling under scheme_v2's gates and reading rules as they stand. J's 13 October rulings bind: the placement is chosen among the readers' themes and my B1's, and no other theme is added. The lone-B1 floor applies only where the readers' theme takes concepts (pass 4's revision; pass 4 placed the six items it had found, and other empties left by B4a-06's floor were not read then). A theme is placed when its must_show takes concepts and no field sends them elsewhere; a second theme needs three concepts (QC1-002). Otherwise the item stays empty. Every item gets a kind: what the material is and why no placement takes it. Saturation by kind: the first position in B1's reading order at which each kind appears, and whether new kinds stopped appearing. Placements go through c1_reassign_list.py, logged, and counted by the guard.
